title: Kevin McCallister ran the greatest defensive game plan in history
hook_text: Home Alone is a sports movie 🧠

lines: Analysts are calling Home Alone a kids' movie.
I'm calling it the greatest defensive performance of all time.
Think about it. An eight-year-old, no coaching staff, no film study, left alone by his own front office.

board.label: COACHING STAFF: 0
board.sub: Front office: on a plane to Paris

lines: Going up against two grown men with years of experience in breaking and entering.
And what does he do? He scouts them. He knows their tendencies. He knows they're coming at nine o'clock.
Then he builds a scheme around his personnel.
Paint cans on the stairs. Ice on the steps. A blowtorch on the front door.
That's not a house. That's a defensive coordinator's playbook.
And the craziest part? He held them scoreless. They never got him.
Say what you want about Rudolph.
But Kevin McCallister is the most underrated coordinator in Christmas history.
